reasons.core_loop: Reminder is the nudge step that makes the schedule actionable.
reasons.adoption: Reminders are used at natural daily frequency with low friction once set.
reasons.differentiation: Reminders are standard in any task app; only the stale-job recheck and generic wording are distinctive.
reasons.enablement: Unlocks little beyond itself (notification preferences feed it, not vice versa).
reasons.parent_value_A2: Removes the repeated chore of reminding a 6-10 child.
reasons.parent_value_A3: Same relief, smaller since 11-14 children self-manage more.
reasons.child_value_A2: Helps with a concrete task but the A2 child is reminded more than self-driven.
reasons.child_value_A3: Supports self-directed task execution and autonomy.
reasons.implementation_effort: Stateful job queue with recheck at dispatch, push integration.
reasons.maintenance_effort: Mostly stable; OS push policy changes.
reasons.latency: Late or stale reminder breaks the outcome.
reasons.complexity: Cross-module rechecks (plan, assignment, preference epoch) and external push provider.
reasons.scalability: Scales linearly with occurrences; peaks at common times.

reasons.core_loop: Supports the planning step by checking load/recovery balance.
reasons.adoption: Runs inside schedule construction; not a user-facing action, so N/A.
reasons.differentiation: Load-and-recovery validation grounded in project's own rules is a distinct value proposition.
reasons.enablement: Gates ready status of schedules; unlocks one core module.
reasons.parent_value_A2: Better plan quality on a weekly decision, felt indirectly.
reasons.parent_value_A3: Same, higher workload at 11-14 makes balance matter more.
reasons.implementation_effort: Rule evaluation with versioned Standard Bar and UNKNOWN handling.
reasons.complexity: Depends on constraints, conflict, and bar versions.

reasons.core_loop: Defines what counts as progress, supporting the report step.
reasons.adoption: Rule engine, no direct user action.
reasons.differentiation: Combination with exceptions and non-labeling is a modest differentiator.
reasons.enablement: Feeds trends, insights and views; unlocks a core group.
reasons.complexity: Depends on event log, tasks, exceptions.

reasons.core_loop: Profile context is needed by planning and recommendations.
reasons.adoption: One-time setup plus updates; completion moderate friction.
reasons.parent_value_A2: Clear help for setup, but not weekly.
reasons.child_value_A2: Parent-entered data, child is not direct beneficiary.
reasons.complexity: Sensitive child data, scope checks, many dependents.

reasons.core_loop: Supports the child-support step but loop closes without it.
reasons.adoption: Opt-in by design; moderate use with friction.
reasons.differentiation: Voluntary, non-profiling check-in with no emotional observation is distinctive.
reasons.parent_value_A2: Parent excluded by design from responses.
reasons.child_value_A2: Helpful but A2 may need more prompting.
reasons.ai_cost_risk: Digest rates Medium; invitation itself is not AI but downstream responses may be.
reasons.complexity: Privacy-sensitive, links to Journal and safety.

reasons.core_loop: Advisory input to goals, not required to close the loop.
reasons.adoption: Used when needed, moderate friction from review.
reasons.differentiation: Evidence-grounded, scope-gated recommendation is a distinct value.
reasons.maintenance_effort: Evidence and framework content upkeep and Vietnamese AI safety evals.

reasons.core_loop: Compliance foundation, not a loop step.
reasons.enablement: Needed by access and purpose checks across modules.

reasons.core_loop: Role views carry the report step.
reasons.differentiation: Child/parent audience separation is a combination advantage.

rubric_ambiguities: adoption_potential N/A vs 1 for engine modules is a judgment call
INDIRECT vs 1 when parent is partly indirect (parent-entered intake)
dependency_enablement score before CP-03 graph is a guess
ai_cost_risk for modules whose digest says Medium but spec has no model call
latency anchor: H for reminders vs M for sync validation is subjective
A2 child_value when feature is parent-driven
